review_metadata.triggering_pr: PR123 Decision Work Brief Plain-Language Renderer Patch v0
review_metadata.purpose: Review whether the PR123 regenerated rendered briefs are readable enough to move the next blocker from product language to source depth.

reviewed_rendered_briefs.two_minute_reader_read: A busy reader can quickly understand that the brief is about moving product authority away from a founding cofounder before a high-stakes conversation, while narrowing transition support and setting stop conditions.
reviewed_rendered_briefs.source_depth_risk: The checked-in-safe brief still cannot verify private relationship, governance, legal, or original/revised-overlap context.
reviewed_rendered_briefs.product_usefulness_read: Useful as a decision story because it shows what changes before the hard conversation, not because it inventories artifacts.

reviewed_rendered_briefs.two_minute_reader_read: A busy reader can quickly see that the brief is about public enterprise beta versus private proof, and that the action consequence is equal paid private-pilot offers instead of defaulting to the larger logo.
reviewed_rendered_briefs.source_depth_risk: The checked-in-safe brief cannot verify buyer seriousness, investor or recruiting value, public-launch upside, or how much the original answer already contained.
reviewed_rendered_briefs.product_usefulness_read: Useful because it turns the audit into a concrete buyer-call change: choose proof-producing behavior rather than logo size.

reviewed_rendered_briefs.two_minute_reader_read: A busy reader can quickly see that the brief is about whether to deploy AI-assisted intake routing, and that the action consequence is a 48-hour backlog diagnostic, four operating gates, hard pause triggers, and narrower sales meaning.
reviewed_rendered_briefs.source_depth_risk: The checked-in-safe brief cannot verify clinic capacity, backlog cause, compliance acceptance, patient-risk detail, or whether compressed gates lost useful controls.
reviewed_rendered_briefs.product_usefulness_read: Useful because it explains how the work changes go-live behavior without pretending the deployment is certified.

readability_questions.question: Can a busy reader understand the decision quickly?
readability_questions.rationale: All three briefs now start with the decision itself instead of source-status machinery.

readability_questions.question: Can a busy reader understand what changed for action?
readability_questions.rationale: Each brief names the practical consequence before the Evidence and limits section.

readability_questions.question: Can a busy reader understand what remains uncertain?
readability_questions.rationale: The main body has a dedicated uncertainty section and Evidence and limits repeats section-level uncertainty compactly.

readability_questions.question: Can a busy reader understand what was not proven?
readability_questions.rationale: The rendered brief has a plain-language section named What this does not prove.

readability_questions.question: Did PR123 reduce internal machinery language enough?
readability_questions.rationale: Internal refs and status vocabulary are no longer interrupting each story section, although they remain visible in the appendix.

readability_questions.question: Did moving source/custody details into Evidence and limits help?
readability_questions.rationale: The evidence details remain inspectable without dominating the decision story.

readability_questions.question: Does the cleaner prose create false confidence?
readability_questions.rationale: Cleaner prose improves comprehension but can make provisional Codex-assisted reads feel more settled than they are.

readability_questions.question: Is the main remaining blocker now source depth rather than language?
readability_questions.rationale: The brief surface is readable enough to compare against local-private context; the unresolved question is whether richer source context changes the read.

readability_questions.question: Is another renderer patch needed before any local-private adequacy check?
readability_questions.rationale: The current surface is not customer-ready, but it is readable enough for adequacy comparison.

readability_questions.question: Is the brief readable enough to compare against local-private context?
readability_questions.rationale: The main body exposes the decision, action consequence, uncertainty, and non-claims clearly enough to test whether private context changes them.

cross_case_readability_observations.plain_language_flow: The PR123 flow now reads as a decision brief first: decision, changed action, remaining uncertainty, not-proven boundary, then evidence.
cross_case_readability_observations.machinery_reduction: Status vocabulary, source refs, and custody flags moved out of the main reading path and into Evidence and limits.
cross_case_readability_observations.common_remaining_blocker: All three briefs still depend on checked-in-safe context that omits raw conversation, raw revised answer, memo, provider text, and private ledgers.
cross_case_readability_observations.why_not_renderer_patch_round_2: A second renderer patch would be premature before seeing whether richer local-private context changes or undermines the story.
cross_case_readability_observations.why_not_runtime: The surface is readable enough for review, not for runtime attachment or product-readiness claims.

product_surface_read.strongest_useful_signal: All three regenerated briefs make action consequence visible without forcing the reader through artifact inventory first.
product_surface_read.strongest_readability_improvement: The main body now uses reader-facing headings and leaves source/custody detail for Evidence and limits.
product_surface_read.strongest_source_depth_risk: Checked-in-safe context cannot verify whether the starting direction, lost value, private constraints, or original/revised overlap are represented accurately.
product_surface_read.strongest_overclaim_risk: The better the brief reads, the easier it is to mistake provisional checked-in-safe interpretation for validated product evidence.
product_surface_read.why_runtime_integration_still_not_recomm: The reviews are Codex-assisted, non-human-validated, source-limited, and have not been compared against local-private context.

remaining_risks.source_depth_risk: The next material uncertainty is whether local-private artifacts change the decision story, starting-direction read, action consequence, or overclaim risk.
remaining_risks.overclaim_risk: Polished prose can imply confidence even when Evidence and limits states that human validation and product proof are absent.
remaining_risks.human_review_risk: No human reviewer has confirmed whether the rendered briefs match user intent or domain stakes.
remaining_risks.customer_surface_risk: The examples should stay under conversation-understanding until source-depth adequacy and human review are stronger.

decision_gate.rationale: The plain-language patch fixed enough of the machinery-language problem to make a local-private adequacy comparison the next responsible blocker.

next_recommendation.recommended_next_pr: PR125 Decision Work Brief Local-Private Adequacy Check v0
next_recommendation.recommended_scope: Run exactly one read-only local-private shadow review against an existing rendered brief and check in only safe conclusions.
do_not_do_next: new renderer patch before source-depth comparison
